errors.text: The hypothesis incorrectly identifies Au as the uniquely highest-vapor-pressure component and consequently underweights Cu; the target mechanism involves both Au and Cu surface segregation, melting, and evaporation.

It attributes disappearance of the smallest particles partly to Ostwald ripening without establishing material transfer to larger particles, whereas the target primarily reports segregation-assisted melting and evaporation with an overall size reduction.
It does not identify the experimentally important onset near 673 K, so its stated breakdown regime is insufficiently temperature-specific.
